en.name: Preserved mustard greens
en.summary: 梅干菜 is the driest member of the Hakka preserved mustard family — sun-dried until there is no water left in it, then rolled into balls. Sealed in the cupboard it keeps about 12–24 months; once opened, about three months for best aroma, which is what you are actually buying.
en.pantry: 梅干菜 is 福菜 that has been sun-dried until completely dry and then rolled into balls, and the reason it keeps longer than its relatives is precisely that there is no water left in it. An airtight jar in a cool dark cupboard, roughly 12–24 months from purchase — a figure borrowed from dried mushrooms, the closest dried, aroma-driven plant product with a published number, since no agency publishes one for 梅干菜. Never put a damp hand or a wet spoon in the jar. A bloom of salt crystals on the surface is normal. After opening, reckon on about three months for best aroma: it stays safe far longer if it stays genuinely dry, but the smoky-sweet smell that is the whole point of the ingredient fades.
en.fridge: The wetter members of this family behave completely differently and should be kept cold. 福菜 is packed damp into an inverted jar and is still a wet pickle; 酸菜 is a straight brine ferment, ready after about a week, and should be kept in its liquid in the fridge once opened. No agency publishes cold-storage times for either, so none are given here — go by the printed date where there is one, keep the greens under their liquid, and use a clean dry utensil every time.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for preserved mustard greens and freezing them is beside the point. 梅干菜 is dried to the point where there is no free water to freeze; the cupboard already does the job, and the freezer adds nothing except condensation when you take the jar in and out. If you have a very large quantity, split it into several small airtight jars rather than freezing one big one.
spoilage: Any fuzzy mould, which on a product this dry means moisture got in
A musty or sour smell instead of the smoky, sweet, dried-vegetable one
Softness or stickiness where the greens should be dry and brittle
tips: Only ever a dry hand and a dry spoon; water is the only thing that can ruin it.
Rinse and soak 梅干菜 before cooking, and let the grit settle rather than pouring the soaking water straight in.
Salt crystals on the surface are normal, not mould.
Store in several small jars rather than one big one so you open the same jar less often.

faq.q: How long does 梅干菜 keep?
faq.a: About 12–24 months sealed in a cool dark cupboard, and about three months after opening for best aroma. Those figures are borrowed from dried mushrooms; no agency publishes one for 梅干菜.
Dry 梅干菜 does not — an airtight jar in the cupboard is right. Wet types like 福菜 and 酸菜 do, kept under their liquid, though no cold-storage times are published for them.

faq.q: What is the white powder on my 梅干菜?
faq.a: Usually salt that has crystallised on the surface, which is normal. Fuzzy growth with colour is mould and means moisture got into the jar.

faq.q: Do you have to wash 梅干菜 before cooking?
faq.a: Yes. Rinse and soak it to remove grit and some of the salt, then let the sediment settle and lift the greens out rather than tipping the whole bowl into the pan.

zh.name: 梅干菜
zh.summary: 梅干菜是客家芥菜醃製家族裡最乾的一員——曬到完全沒有水分，再揉成一團團。密封放在櫥櫃約可放 12～24 個月；開封後以三個月為香氣的參考期限，而香氣正是你真正買的東西。
zh.pantry: 梅干菜是把福菜曬到完全乾燥後揉成球狀的成品，而它比同家族其他產品更耐放的原因，正是它裡面已經沒有水分了。請用密封罐放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起約 12～24 個月——這個數字是比照乾香菇而來，那是最接近的「乾燥、以香氣為賣點的植物性產品」，而且有公布數字；梅干菜本身則沒有任何單位公布過。絕對不要用濕的手或濕湯匙伸進罐子裡。表面析出的鹽結晶是正常的。開封後請以大約三個月為香氣期限：只要真的保持乾燥，它在安全上可以放久得多，但那股煙燻帶甜的香氣——也就是這個食材的全部意義——會逐漸消散。
zh.fridge: 這個家族裡比較濕的成員表現完全不同，應該冷藏。福菜是趁濕塞進倒扣的罐子裡，本質上仍是濕醃菜；酸菜則是單純的鹽水發酵，大約一週就可食用，開封後應連同醃汁冷藏。這兩者都沒有任何單位公布冷藏保存期限，所以這裡也不提供——有印製日期的就以日期為準，菜要壓在醃汁底下，每次都用乾淨的乾器具。
zh.freezer: 梅干菜沒有冷凍保存期限，冷凍也偏離重點。它已經乾到沒有游離水可以結凍；櫥櫃本來就能勝任，冷凍除了每次進出造成的水氣凝結之外，什麼也沒增加。如果量非常大，請分裝成好幾個小密封罐，而不是整批冷凍。
spoilage: 出現任何毛狀黴——在這麼乾的產品上，這代表水氣跑進去了
有霉味或酸味，而不是煙燻甘甜的乾菜香
原本應該乾硬易脆的地方變得柔軟或黏手
tips: 永遠只用乾的手和乾的湯匙；唯一能毀掉它的就是水。
烹調前先沖洗浸泡，讓砂沉澱後把菜撈起來，不要連泡的水一起倒下鍋。
表面的鹽結晶是正常現象，不是發霉。
分裝成幾個小罐而不是一個大罐，同一罐被打開的次數就少了。

faq.a: 密封放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 12～24 個月；開封後以三個月為香氣參考期限。這些數字是比照乾香菇而來；梅干菜本身沒有公布的數據。
乾的梅干菜不用，密封放櫥櫃就對了。福菜、酸菜這類濕的要冷藏，並壓在醃汁底下；不過這兩者都沒有公布的冷藏期限。

faq.q: 梅干菜上的白粉是什麼？
faq.a: 通常是表面析出的鹽結晶，屬正常現象。若是帶顏色的絨毛狀物，那就是發霉，代表水氣進到罐子裡了。
要。先沖洗浸泡去掉泥砂和部分鹽分，然後等沉澱物沉底，把菜撈起來，不要整碗倒進鍋裡。
